meta.units: M = 1 (reduced Planck mass), K0 = 1, chi = 1/M^4, m^2 = 2/3 M^2; t in 1/M
meta.Gamma: N_s m^3/(192 pi M^2), N_s = 4, effective source [Q/E]
meta.fractions: f_inj = int Q a^3 dt / (rho_V,i a_i^3) (energy handed to radiation, counted at injection); f_com = rho_r a^4 (end) / (rho_V,i a_i^4) (comoving radiation, a_i = 1)
